model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” (y-axis, ranging from 0 to 30 with major gridlines at intervals of 10) of five different language models—XLM-L₂ (light blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red)—across nine linguistic groupings on the x-axis: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. Each grouping displays five vertically stacked bars representing the respective models, with error bars indicating variability. The tallest bars, reaching up to approximately 25, appear in the IE-Indic and Semitic groups for XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂, while the shortest bars, near zero, are observed in the Isolate and Uralic groups for most models. The bars are not sorted by height within each group, and no single model consistently outperforms others across all groups; for instance, XLM-B₂ performs strongly in IE-Indic and Semitic, while mBERT-R₂ shows higher effects in IE-Indic and IE-Slavic. The chart uses color-coded bars with a legend positioned in the upper right, and all bars are aligned to a common baseline with error bars extending both above and below the bar tops.
